title: `FieldSchema`: declare the target for the retired `id_field` spelling so objectui's ingestion choke point can canonicalise it (objectui#7650 ruling A)
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #17, `session_01XesLUWmuhjuRwmU618AZ1M`) as the spec half of a ruling on objectui#7650 (maintainer 「同意」, decision batch #1, 2026-09-07). Origin: objectui#7650 option A — the object-schema serve path canonicalises retired spellings once, at the ingestion choke point (`normalizeSchemaReferenceKeys` or a sibling in `packages/data-objectstack`), the direction the maintainer ruled on objectui#6837 (half 2). ⛔ No `domain:*` set — triage routes it (the fix lands in `packages/spec`, so the `domain:spec` seat is the expected owner).

## What is owed here

objectui's routing note (objectui#7650 comment 5548681932) measured that `id_field` is the one retired key whose canonical target is **not declared** on `FieldSchema`: `display_field` / `description_field` / `lookup_filters` each have a declared canonical member the choke point can fold onto; `id_field` has none, so objectui cannot canonicalise it until the spec says what it becomes.

Deliverable: declare on `FieldSchema` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` or wherever the lookup/master_detail reference members live — re-derive on `origin/main`) the canonical member that `id_field` maps onto, with its docblock, strictness ledger row and contract test; or, if the ruled shape is that `id_field` has no successor, record that in the ledger so objectui's choke point can drop it with a loud diagnostic instead of folding it. Either way the answer is a declared, tested fact on the spec, not prose.

Executable criterion: after this lands, objectui's ingestion normaliser can be extended for `id_field` with a target it reads from `@objectstack/spec` types, and the retirement cards in the `display_field` / `description_field` / `id_field` / `lookup_filters` family can cite the choke point rather than schema strictness.

Downstream: objectui#7650's `id_field` slice carries `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#<this card>`; the other three keys proceed there without waiting. `Clause-②`: likely **yes** (a published schema gains or renames a member) — claim at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` or with the carrier as compensation.

Dedupe: `search_issues` over this repo for "id_field FieldSchema target canonical retired" returned no card on this shape; the control query for objectui#7650 hit. Governing text: objectui#6837 ruling (canonicalise once at ingestion, never at the consumer); ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove.
